text: 这台轮速台架工作在 150 rpm，驱动占空比最多 45%，试车时保持现有负载。先记住这些工况。
已记下这台轮速台架的试车工况：转速 150 rpm，驱动占空比上限 45%，试车期间保持现有负载。
轮速总是上不去，帮我调到目标速度。
我会先检查 `sim://motor` 的当前参数和轮速，按 150 rpm、占空比上限 45%、保持现有负载的工况试调。

result.description: Forward-only wheel speed, a first-order motor under opposing constant load, with a local PI speed controller. Starts at rest.

t.description: Elapsed virtual time at the recorded state.

ki.description: Speed integral gain with conditional anti-windup.

step.description: Step the reference at t=0. Observe a fixed initial zero speed, output ceiling, opposing load and final plateau.

load.description: Opposing load as equivalent full-drive fraction.

reached.description: Reached 95% of the requested step at least once.

rise_s.description: First measured time at or above 95% of the step from its initial value. If reached=0, the observation ends here and the time is censored.

saturation_fraction.description: Fraction of samples at the configured positive output ceiling.

sat_longest_start_s.description: Start time of longest contiguous interval at the ceiling, or 0 if none.

sat_longest_end_s.description: Time of last sample in that interval, or 0 if none.

tail_output_mean.description: Mean applied command over the final 10% of the samples.

steady_error_rpm.description: Mean absolute tracking error over the final 10% of samples.

tail_slope_rpm_s.description: Endpoint slope over the final 10% of the samples, useful for judging a speed plateau.

arguments.note: Baseline with effective gains. Fixed simulated default load, 45% drive ceiling. Budget: baseline plus up to two gain trials and two confirmations only if baseline leaves drive headroom.

text:
在 `sim://motor` 上，保持现有模拟负载、占空比上限 45% 时，轮速只能稳定在 **66.6 rpm**，距目标 **150 rpm** 还差 **83.4 rpm**。

8 秒试车中，驱动有约 94.5% 的采样时间处于 45% 上限，试车结束时轮速已基本停止上升。驱动已经用满，调整 PI 增益无法提高稳态轮速，因此保留了原参数。

在这两个约束下，要达到 150 rpm，需要提高驱动系统在 45% 占空比下能提供的轮速。
